panel_description_zh: 中景仰视 20 度斜对角，老哥（李斌）半身，双手正在调整三脚架云台，手指捏着小卡扣；穿宽松灰色棉质圆领T恤略显皱褶；不拍脸；背景虚化白墙墙角。

dialogue_or_narration.speaker: MC 鲁迅
dialogue_or_narration.text_zh: 我经常在一些相亲交流会上播放。

prompt_en: Chinese modern comic style, contemporary urban realism, soft cinematic lighting, naturalistic proportions. Low-angle medium shot tilted up about 20 degrees on a diagonal axis. The camera deliberately frames only from the chest down, not showing the face, of a 30-something East Asian Chinese man. Wearing a loose grey cotton crew-neck t-shirt, slightly wrinkled and faded from many washes. Navy blue plaid pajama pants visible at the waistband. Both hands are adjusting a small quick-release clamp on a tripod head in front of him. Shoulders slightly slumped and neck slightly forward — the man's posture is deflated and quiet. Background a soft-focus plain white wall corner, no decoration. Cool blue-grey ambient light with a slight warm bias from the living room. Quiet, methodical, almost shy mood. Text watermark 'P01-PN04' in the bottom-right corner.
negative_prompt_en: the man's face visible, anime proportions, muscular arms, sharp focused background, daylight streaming through window, any female figure in frame, branded logos on the t-shirt, a confident upright posture
